content.title: 9-1-3-1. Nonconforming drive-in or drive-through facilities.
content.summary: A.	Nonconforming Due to Design or Configuration.

faqs.a:
A.	Nonconforming Due to Design or Configuration. If a drive-in or drive-through facility is nonconforming because it is not in compliance with the provisions of Section 5-1-6-2, Drive-In and Drive-Through Facilities, then:
  1.	If the nonconformity involves the location of the drive-in or drive-through facility adjacent to any RA or RN zoning districts or within the OT zoning district, then the use of the drive-in or drive-through facility shall not be resumed if it is discontinued for a period of six consecutive months unless the drive-in or drive-through element of the facility shall be modified to become less nonconforming, as determined by the Director; or
  2.	For any other nonconformity, the use of the drive-in or drive-through facility may be continued, or resumed after interruption, and the drive-in or drive-through facility is subject to Section 9-1-3-2, Modifications to a Nonconforming Building or Structure, and Section 9-1-3-3, Damage to a Nonconforming Building or Structure.
